features: Adds a fixed right-edge MEMO tab that opens a cyberpunk memo drawer without changing existing market cards, charts, filters, analysis or research behavior.
Memo records contain Taiwan date/time, symbol and free-text note, with checkbox multi-select deletion.
Memo persistence is server-side through the existing Cloudflare Worker and JSON_BUCKET R2 binding at terminal/memos.json, so records synchronize across devices instead of relying on localStorage.
Adds GET/POST/DELETE /api/memos endpoints and DELETE CORS support. The memo interface reloads from R2 whenever opened and immediately refreshes after save/delete.
All unspecified Terminal UI and engine logic remain unchanged.
